core_thesis: The strategic risk to the United States is not limited to direct disruption of US domestic infrastructure. A coordinated foreign filtering ecosystem can leave US systems technically healthy while progressively isolating foreign populations from US services, independent media and direct interpersonal channels; substitute locally controlled information sources; and create an observability gap in which the United States receives slower, narrower or more biased evidence of public attitudes and network conditions abroad.
important_correction: US awareness would not become zero. Embassies, intelligence collection, satellite communications, diaspora communities, global providers, measurement platforms and circumvention users provide alternate observation channels. The defensible risk is DEGRADED_OR_DELAYED_OBSERVABILITY rather than AMERICA_WILL_NOT_KNOW.

mechanisms: Block or throttle US-hosted media, social networks, developer platforms, cloud/CDN services and encrypted communications.
Block VPN/circumvention and app distribution paths needed to restore access.
Use allowlists or protocol-level filtering so technically unblocked domains remain unreliable.
threat_chain.strategic_effect: Direct contact between foreign populations and US/open information sources shrinks while the US service itself remains healthy.

mechanisms: Promote domestic/state-compliant messengers, search, hosting, news and social platforms as replacements.
Move discovery and social communication onto surfaces with stronger local moderation, surveillance or agenda control.
threat_chain.strategic_effect: The information diet becomes easier for the local state or aligned actors to shape even without fabricating every item.

mechanisms: Repeated framing of geopolitical events through anti-US or anti-West narratives.
Reduce visibility of contradictory reporting and increase repetition of state-aligned interpretations.
Exploit ordinary grievances, economic disruption or service outages as narrative evidence against the United States.
threat_chain.strategic_effect: Public attitudes can move without a corresponding change in US policy or infrastructure because the accessible evidence environment has changed.

mechanisms: Foreign users cannot reliably reach US platforms while US-side availability metrics remain green.
Local platforms and censored networks expose less representative public sentiment to outside observers.
Outages and filtering can be misclassified as provider failures when measured only from US or Western vantage points.
threat_chain.strategic_effect: US institutions can underestimate the scale, timing or cause of information isolation unless they maintain foreign-vantage measurements and human reporting.

mechanisms: Similar filtering rules activate across several networks or countries sharing vendor, policy or security relationships.
The same US information/service categories degrade within a narrow time window.
Narrative themes and technical restrictions reinforce each other across borders.
threat_chain.strategic_effect: A regional information sphere can partially decouple from US/open networks without disrupting the American domestic Internet.

observations.finding: Human Rights Watch reports continued censorship of information and opinions about the war in Ukraine that do not align with the official narrative, large-scale blocking of sites, expansion of VPN restrictions, and promotion of Russian online services as alternatives to blocked services.

Human Rights Watch's August 24, 2026 briefing reports more than 1.8 million websites blocked in Russia, extensive VPN blocking, communication-app restrictions, and periods in which mobile networks use narrow allowlists.
Freedom House describes pervasive hyperpatriotic propaganda, state control over online/offline expression and legal pressure on political speech as cumulative constraints on open discussion.

Official Kremlin rhetoric has explicitly framed Western actors as fighting Russia through Ukraine; in a published presidential transcript Putin told European interlocutors that 'you are fighting us through Ukrainian nationalists'.
observations.note: This records official rhetoric and does not validate the factual truth of the claim.

github_russia_note.finding: There are 2026 user reports of severe GitHub/GitHub-dependent connectivity problems and documented GitHub Copilot regional restrictions, but the available evidence in this pass does not support encoding github.com itself as a confirmed nationwide Russian block.
controls: GitHub's own trade-control documentation distinguishes product/export restrictions from Russian censorship.
A live third-party accessibility aggregator classified github.com as accessible in Russia on 2026-08-28, but with low confidence and only eight measurements.
The operator's first-hand experience may be preserved separately as USER_OBSERVED rather than promoted to nationwide FACT without cross-AS measurement.

early_warning_indicators.indicator: US/open information sources become unreachable or unreliable across multiple foreign ASes while local/state-aligned substitutes remain healthy.
early_warning_indicators.required_control: Matched US-side service health plus uncensored neighboring/alternate-AS vantage.

early_warning_indicators.indicator: VPN, ECH, QUIC, encrypted DNS, app-store or circumvention transport blocking increases immediately before or during content-source restrictions.
early_warning_indicators.required_control: Protocol fingerprint and path localization, not user complaint count alone.

early_warning_indicators.indicator: Multiple countries/operators sharing Russian-origin DPI/SORM vendor lineage introduce semantically similar restrictions within a narrow time window.
early_warning_indicators.required_control: Independent measurement from each country and evidence of common vendor/policy lineage.

early_warning_indicators.indicator: State or state-aligned platforms are promoted as replacements at the same time external communication surfaces are degraded.
early_warning_indicators.required_control: Official policy/platform statements plus independent reachability data.

early_warning_indicators.indicator: Anti-US narratives spike after access to US/independent counter-sources is reduced.
early_warning_indicators.required_control: Content time-series with pre-restriction baseline and multiple media/social sources; correlation alone does not prove central coordination.

early_warning_indicators.indicator: US-side availability dashboards remain normal while foreign-vantage measurements show geographically clustered failures.
early_warning_indicators.required_control: Same endpoint, same time, paired foreign and control vantage measurements.

forecast_scenarios.name: SOVEREIGN_BUBBLE_REPLICATION
forecast_scenarios.description: A foreign government adopts Russian-origin filtering/surveillance technology and progressively reproduces the Russian pattern: external-service restriction, circumvention suppression and domestic-platform substitution.
forecast_scenarios.us_impact: Loss of direct information/service reach into that society; reduced quality of public-opinion observation; elevated propaganda susceptibility.

forecast_scenarios.name: REGIONAL_INFORMATION_CURTAIN
forecast_scenarios.description: Several states or operators synchronize filtering against categories of US/open services while preserving local/regional substitutes.
forecast_scenarios.us_impact: A multi-country audience can become partially detached from US sources even though US infrastructure remains healthy.

forecast_scenarios.name: CRISIS_WINDOW_NARRATIVE_LOCK
forecast_scenarios.description: During war, sanctions, elections or another crisis, technical filtering and state messaging intensify together for a short high-impact window.
forecast_scenarios.us_impact: Foreign populations encounter a narrowed information environment exactly when attitudes and decisions are most sensitive.

forecast_scenarios.name: FALSE_PROVIDER_OUTAGE_COVER
forecast_scenarios.description: Selective external-service blocking resembles an ordinary US provider/CDN outage to users and analysts lacking foreign-vantage telemetry.
forecast_scenarios.us_impact: Delayed attribution and slower diplomatic/provider response while the affected population is told that the external service or the United States is responsible.

defensive_us_observability_requirements: Foreign-vantage reachability probes to US media, government, cloud, developer, communications and circumvention endpoints.
Paired measurement of state/local substitute platforms to distinguish generalized outages from selective information isolation.
BGP/AS-path, DNS, TLS/QUIC and packet-fingerprint telemetry attached to each reachability event.
Independent human reporting from journalists, civil society, businesses, embassies and diaspora communities.
Narrative time-series that measure which explanations are promoted before, during and after technical restrictions.
Strict separation of provider outage, sanctions/product restriction, local operator failure, censorship and coordinated foreign activation.
